# `app.graycard.catalog.meterType`

A light-meter model in the shareable gear catalog (handheld ambient/spot/flash meters, color meters, and phone-app meters). Mirrors the conventions of the other catalog.* records: manufacturer identity, structured specifications, and edition-aware document citations via defs#productDocument / defs#specSource.

- **Source:** `lexicons/app/graycard/catalog/meterType.json`
- **Lexicon version:** `1`
- **Definitions:** 1
